lines.text: I got two tickets for the film on Friday. My brother is coming with me.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Nice! What time does it end? I might meet you after the film.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: It ends around eight. Would you like to get something to drink then?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. Where should we meet? I have never been to that cinema.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: There is a small cafe across from the cinema. It stays open until ten.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Is that the cafe with the yellow door? I think I saw it yesterday.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, that's the one. Let us meet inside at eight fifteen.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sounds good. I will get a table if I get there first.
lines.speaker: Eli
